findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent non-development calls can all observe a nil cache before the first caller acquires this lock. After that caller initializes the cache, every queued caller still reopens and parses assets-manifest.json because the cache is not checked again under the write lock. These redundant loads now run serially and also block cache-hit readers behind pending writers, creating an avoidable cold-start bottleneck. After acquiring the write lock, check entryPointAssetsCache again when not in development mode and return it if another caller has populated it.
